You must be a well-experienced fighter, otherwise you'd never be able to arrive here after passing the steep, mountainous areas and dangerous creatures surrounding this city.
scripts.translation: 你一定身經百戰，不然，哪能翻過城外陡峭的山路，躲過那些危險生物，來到這裡。

scripts.text: I'm no expert at fighting, but someone once told me that sheer strength alone won't be able to win some battles.
scripts.translation: 我不懂打仗，不過，有人告訴過我，有些戰鬥光靠蠻力是贏不了的。

scripts.text: Sometimes, you may encounter creatures protected by a hard-shell that don't be damaged by physical attacks. Only psychic power, like Magic, can easily defeat such creatures.
scripts.translation: 有時候，會遇到外殼堅硬的生物，物理攻擊傷不了它們。只有魔法這樣的精神力量，才能輕鬆擊敗它們。

scripts.text: Of course, not everyone can study magic. The point is that you should keep different kinds of friends and comrades close to you, as you can't possibly handle every situation by yourself.
scripts.translation: 當然，不是誰都能學魔法。重要的是，身邊要有各有所長的朋友和夥伴。畢竟，你不可能獨自應付所有情況。

scripts.text: I remember the story my dearly departed grandfather has told me.
scripts.translation: 我還記得，已故的爺爺生前講過一個故事。

scripts.text: It's about this Amulet that possesses an Evil Power.
scripts.translation: 故事裡，有個帶著邪惡力量的護身符。

scripts.text: Well, I'm not sure if it's true or not. But, I wonder, what would happen if I used it to summon

scripts.translation: 這裡是斐揚中央宮，對公眾開放。不過，按照規定，進入後請遵守秩序。

scripts.translation: 城外的魔物越來越多，遊客也越來越少，最近清靜多了。

scripts.text: To be honest, things are getting tough because of all those monsters. ^666666*Sigh...*^000000

scripts.text: Whoa~! I just noticed those arms of yours look pretty solid. You look pretty strong, guy. Just how many monsters have you killed?!
scripts.translation: 哇~！剛發現，你的胳膊真結實。小夥子，看著就很有力氣。你到底打倒過多少魔物？！

scripts.text: Oooh! I didn't notice before, but you look pretty strong beneath all of that feminine charm.
scripts.translation: 哦！剛才沒注意，原來你這麼有女人味，身手卻也很厲害呢。

scripts.text: Hey, I know of a good place for you to hunt. It just so happens that there's a cave in the middle of Payon.
scripts.translation: 嘿，我知道一個適合你狩獵的好地方。斐揚正好有個洞穴。

scripts.text: If you're interested, just head North, pass the forest, and go towards the Northwest. You'll know you've arrived when you're in the place filled with the smell of stinky monsters.
scripts.translation: 有興趣的話，就往北走，穿過樹林，再往西北去。到了滿是魔物臭味的地方，你就知道找對了。

scripts.text: Payon is located deep inside the forest where it can easily be attacked by hordes of monsters. Monsters also come from the dangerous cave located near town.
scripts.translation: 斐揚位於森林深處，很容易遭到成群魔物的襲擊。此外，靠近城鎮的危險洞穴裡也常有魔物出沒。

scripts.text: Since Undead monsters roam the Payon Cave, it has attracted the attention of the monster academic world. My job here is to analyze their characteristics.
scripts.translation: 斐揚洞穴中徘徊著不死系魔物，引起了魔物學界的關注。我的工作，就是在這裡研究它們的特性。

scripts.text: What is most remarkable of the Undead monsters in Payon is their origin Most of them used to be citizens of Payon!
scripts.translation: 斐揚不死系魔物最值得注意的，是它們的來歷：大多曾經是斐揚居民！

scripts.text: unable to rest in peace and still wander about as Undead bound

scripts.text: These monsters cannot be classified with other monsters that have mutated from living creatures, so our wise and benevolent ruler, King Tristram III, has taken a great interest in Payon's Undead.
scripts.translation: 它們與那些由活物變異而成的魔物，不能歸為一類。因此，我們英明仁慈的國王特里斯坦三世，對斐揚的不死系魔物十分關注。

scripts.text: Talented people around the world have joined forces in an effort to deduce the origin of monsters, and a way to eliminate them once and for all.

scripts.text: In our missions, the number of victims of monster attacks have been countless. Still, nothing can stop us. If our suffering can save humanity, so be it!
scripts.translation: 執行任務時，我們已有無數人遭到魔物襲擊。可什麼也阻止不了我們！只要這份苦難能拯救人類，我們就甘願承受！

scripts.text: He used to menace the monsters in Payon Forest, carrying his Gakkung. I remember watching him fight when I was just a little kid.
scripts.translation: 他以前拿著角弓，在斐揚樹林裡打得魔物聞風喪膽。我小時候，還親眼看過他戰鬥。

scripts.text: Still, his eyes are as sharp as they used to be during his days

scripts.text: The quality of the wood often determines the quality of the Bow. My lil' sweety was made out of a walnut tree, and is strong enough to bear thousands of pounds
scripts.translation: 木材的質量往往決定了弓的質量。我的小甜心是用胡桃木做的，堅固得足以承受數千磅的拉

scripts.text: Oh, and the trees in Payon Forest are famous for the quality of their wood. But then, more and more of them have been turning into monsters. Is this the work of evil forces?!
scripts.translation: 斐揚樹林的木材，質量可是出了名的。可越來越多的樹變成了魔物。難道是邪惡力量在作祟？！

scripts.text: It's a pity because the tree monsters used to be beautiful, majestic trees. But then it's okay if we kill them, so that we can make Bows out of their wood.
scripts.translation: 真可惜，那些樹魔物原本都是美麗高大的樹。不過，打倒它們也好，木材還能拿來做弓。

scripts.text: And then we use these Bows to kill even more tree monsters... And then make more wood! Mwahahahaha! It's an endless cycle!

scripts.text: We Archers are here to protect our territory against them, as ordered by our honorable chief!
scripts.translation: 我們弓箭手奉首領之命，守在這裡，保護領地不受它們侵害！

scripts.text: But since these monsters endlessly respawn, sometimes I feel like we're wasting our time and energy for nothing...
scripts.translation: 可魔物總是不斷重生，有時候真覺得，我們是在白白浪費時間和力氣...

scripts.text: He always working to make sure

scripts.translation: 究竟預示著什麼壞事，我也說不清。也許斐揚出了問題，也許是他有什麼事得自己處理。反正，不知為什麼，他房裡總有衛兵守著。

scripts.text: I'll get in trouble if he knows
I told an outsider know too much about his affairs. Oh well! It's too late. I already told you! There's no use regretting it!
scripts.translation: 的事說給外人聽了這麼多，我可要倒霉了。算啦！已經說出口，後悔也沒用！

scripts.text: It's not too late for me to just shut my mouth. Keep it closed. Shutting up now. Quiet as a mouse. Seeya later~!
scripts.translation: ...現在閉嘴還來得及。嘴閉好，不說了，安靜得像只小老鼠。回頭見~！

scripts.text: Though, you may have a point
there. I mean, you should be able to practice without having to suffer serious consequences.
scripts.translation: 理。練習嘛，應該不至於付出慘重代價。比如

scripts.text: Are you tired of me repeating the same thing over and over again?
Oh, just bear with me. Think of it as practicing your patience~
to set aside time to rest.
But it's also a good idea to set aside time for practicing and training, and practicing and training!
scripts.translation: 不過，也得留時間練習和訓練，再練習、再訓練！

scripts.text: And it's a very bad idea to rest when you should be alert, or well, when you're supposed to be doing something else.
scripts.translation: 可該警惕的時候，或者，嗯，該做其他事的時候，跑去休息就不對了。

scripts.text: That reminds me of the time
I set fire to my house during the holidays. It was an accident, of course, but boy, were my folks angry!
scripts.translation: 次過節，我把家燒了。當然是意外，可家裡人真氣壞了！

scripts.text: It all started when I decided to take a bath. Here, in Payon, we use the old style baths, so we need to make a fire to heat the water. Cold baths are just so uncomfortable.
scripts.translation: 哈~事情是從我想洗澡開始的。斐揚用的是老式浴池，得生火燒水。冷水澡可太難受了。

scripts.text: But nice, warm baths are veeeery comfortable. That was probably the best bath I had in my life! It was so comfortable, I fell asleep.
scripts.translation: 可泡熱水澡，真是舒——服。那大概是我這輩子最舒服的一次！舒服得我都睡著了。

scripts.text: I guess I didn't notice the fire reach the floor, walls and ceiling! Luckily, I was in a tub full of water, so I was okay.
scripts.translation: 燒到地板、牆壁、屋頂，我都沒察覺！幸好浴缸裡全是水，我才沒事。

scripts.text: I would've gotten help if it weren't for the fact that the fire had burned my clothes while I was napping. So, of course, I couldn't just run around town in the nude.
scripts.translation: 要不是衣服也在我打盹時燒掉了，我早就跑出去求救了。可我總不能光著身子滿城跑吧。

scripts.text: I just sat in the water for about an hour, completely naked, and yelling 'Help me,' until someone could hear me.
scripts.translation: ...我就光著身子在水裡坐了大約一小時，一直喊“救命”，盼著有人聽見。

scripts.text: But, it turned out that no one could hear me. Luckily, our roof caved in and totally demolished our walls so that my screams could finally reach passerby. And it was in that way that I survived.
scripts.translation: 可偏偏沒人聽見。幸好，屋頂塌了，連牆都砸沒了，路人才終於聽到我的叫聲。我就是這麼活下來的。

scripts.text: Um, what's the point of that story?
scripts.translation: 呃，講這個故事有什麼意義嗎？

scripts.text: I guess I better not get lazy then.
Resting during the right times is perfectly fine. Just don't go and take a break when you shouldn't. That kind of behavior would make anyone in our town angry!
scripts.translation: 該休息時休息，完全沒問題。可不該歇著的時候，就別偷懶。這種行為，我們鎮上誰看了都會生氣！

scripts.text: Our chief is especially annoyed by that kind of irresponsible attitude. I guess, around here, only the town drunkard subscribes to that kind of policy.
scripts.translation: 我們的首領尤其討厭這種不負責任的態度。我想，在這裡，只有鎮上的酒鬼才認同這種作風。

scripts.text: Our chief? Ah, he's such a swell guy. Then again, he's always scolds me for talking too much.
scripts.translation: 首領？啊，他人可好了。不過，老是嫌我話多，訓我。

scripts.text: He always working to make sure
that Payon is safe from harm. Lately, I've been worried since he hasn't been coming out the Palace lately. That might be a bad sign...
scripts.translation: 護斐揚免受侵害。可最近老不見他出宮，我有點擔心。這可能不是什麼好兆頭...

scripts.text: A bad sign of what, I'm not really sure. There could be problems with Payon, or maybe he's got something he needs to handle on his own. Anyway, there's always guards in his room for some reason.
scripts.translation: 究竟預示著什麼壞事，我也說不清。也許斐揚出了問題，也許是他有什麼事得自己處理。反正，不知為什麼，他房裡總有衛兵守著。

scripts.text: I'll get in trouble if he knows
I told an outsider know too much about his affairs. Oh well! It's too late. I already told you! There's no use regretting it!
scripts.translation: 的事告訴外人這麼多，我可要倒霉了。算啦！已經說出口，後悔也沒用！

scripts.text: It's not too late for me to just shut my mouth. Complete silence. I'm not even opening my mouth. Starting right about... Now!
scripts.translation: ...現在閉嘴還來得及。完全不出聲，連嘴都不張。就從...現在開始！回

scripts.text: Or as much as he does...
We, as Archers, put a lot of importance on training and practice, so we kind of look
scripts.translation: 我們弓箭手很重視訓練和練習，所以，多少有點

scripts.text: I have to admit that, at heart,
I'm a pretty lazy guy. I guess it's pretty amazing that someone like
scripts.translation: 裡是個挺懶散的人。像我這樣的人居然能當上弓箭手，

scripts.text: me can even be an Archer!
Please tell me about the cave.
Payon is the city of highlanders. As long as our history can relate, our city has been self-sufficient.
scripts.translation: 斐揚是山地居民的城市。自有歷史記載以來，我們就一直自給自足。

scripts.text: Although our ancestors did not enjoy the benefits of cultural exchange with the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom as we do today, they knew how to make a living without
scripts.translation: 我們的祖先雖不像今天這樣，能與盧恩·米德加茲王國交流文化、從中受益，卻也懂得不靠外人，自食

scripts.text: Payon has developed its own cultures and ways. We've invented our own means to protect ourselves against the elements, and Payon men and women train as Archers and Hunters to defend themselves.
scripts.translation: 斐揚有自己的文化與生活方式。我們想出了應對風霜雨雪的方法，男女居民也都練習弓箭和狩獵，保衛自己。
聽說有些年輕人軟弱膽

scripts.text: young people who fear the fields or dungeons filled with monsters. But to us, battle is a way of life.
scripts.translation: 小，畏懼遍佈魔物的野外和地下城。可對我們來說，戰鬥本就是生活的一部分。

scripts.text: That is why his Majesty, King Tristram III wishes for us to train young people how to effectively fight against evil creatures.
scripts.translation: 所以，特里斯坦三世陛下希望我們教導年輕人，讓他們懂得如何有效對抗邪惡生物。

scripts.text: Royal troops, Kafra Ladies, Guards... At first, there was conflict brought about by differences in our customs
scripts.translation: 王國軍、卡普拉小姐、衛兵...起初，我們的習俗與文化不同，也鬧過一

scripts.text: we've been able to resolve such petty differences. I cannot deny that they've helped us speedily develop our trade with foreign nations.
scripts.translation: 推移，我們已能化解這些瑣碎的分歧。不可否認，他們幫助我們迅速發展與外國的貿易。

scripts.text: Now, people who used to be outsiders are now bonifide Payon citizens. When I was young, I would never imagined such a thing possible. Hahahaha~!
scripts.translation: 如今，曾經的外來者已成為真正的斐揚市民。在我年輕時，我從未想過會有這樣的一天。哈哈哈~！

scripts.text: It pleases me to see and meet with them. Even though have come from other places, they have a love for Payon that is as sincere as my own.
scripts.translation: 見到並結識他們讓我感到欣慰。儘管他們來自其他地方，但他們對斐揚的熱愛與我一樣真摯。

scripts.text: I used to go to the cave
to the North sometimes. But it
is harder now than it was then.
Evil creatures that I've never seen before endlessly respawn in that place. The monsters in Payon Cave today are different than the ones we used to fight with.
scripts.translation: 那裡不斷出現我從未見過的邪惡生物。如今斐揚洞穴的魔物，已不同於我們過去交手的那些。

scripts.text: Have you ever happened to see
the Zombies...? Some of them are warriors who entered the cave to protect this village, but never came back.
scripts.translation: ..？其中有些，曾是為了保護村莊而進入洞穴的戰士，卻再也沒回來。

scripts.text: Although they are a threat, some of those Undead are also victims of that cave. I'm too old to endure that kind of pain...
scripts.translation: 那些亡靈雖是威脅，可有些也是洞穴的受害者。我老了，已經難以承受這種痛苦...

scripts.text: I must do anything I can to stop the Undead, and release their souls from eternal anguish.
scripts.translation: 我必須盡力阻止這些亡靈，讓他們的靈魂擺脫永無止境的苦痛。

scripts.text: Ah, it is fortunate that archery is a specialty here in Payon. Because of the surrounding forest, we have an abundant supply of wood to create Bows.
scripts.translation: 所幸，斐揚向來擅長弓術。四周森林茂密，有充足的木材可以造弓。

scripts.text: The forest also is a good training place for Archers to learn how to use their environment to impede the advance of their enemies while attacking from a safe distance.
scripts.translation: 森林也是弓箭手練習的好地方，能學著利用地形阻礙敵人接近，從安全距離發動攻擊。

scripts.text: The forest can also be convenient in unexpected ways. When I was young, I ran out of arrows while fighting against monsters in the woods, but arrows dropped by other monsters saved my life! Mwahah!
scripts.translation: 森林有時也能提供意想不到的幫助。我年輕時，在林中打魔物打光了箭，幸好其他魔物掉落的箭救了我！哇哈哈！

scripts.text: As foreign cultures were introduced to Payon, changes have been brought about to our battle style.
scripts.translation: 隨著外來文化傳入斐揚，我們的戰鬥風格也發生了變化。

scripts.text: Technology, especially that of explosives, enabled new methods
scripts.translation: 技術，尤其是火藥技術，帶來了新

scripts.text: of battle. We were no longer limited to the use of just bows and arrows.
scripts.translation: 的戰鬥方法。我們不再只能使用弓箭。

scripts.text: hunting monsters much easier, were developed enable here in Payon. Experts in the new skills were dubbed 'Hunters' by our previous Chief.
scripts.translation: 阱技術，獵殺魔物也容易多了。前任首領把精通這些新技能的人，稱為“獵人”。

scripts.text: Although highly effective, trapping is a really dangerous skill if not used properly. That's why we do not approve of the inexperienced becoming Hunters.
scripts.translation: 陷阱雖有效，可使用不當也非常危險。因此，我們不會讓缺乏經驗的人轉職為獵人。

scripts.text: who have proven to be capable to take the challenge of the Hunter class.
scripts.translation: 身實力的人，我們歡迎他們來接受獵人的考驗。

scripts.text: You know the Archers of Payon!
scripts.translation: 原來你知道斐揚弓箭手

scripts.text: We never miss our target! Even from a distance, the hearts of our foes are unsafe!
scripts.translation: ！我們箭無虛發！就算離得再遠，敵人的心臟也別想安然無恙！

scripts.text: So, you like this place, huh?
scripts.translation: 所以，你喜歡這個地方，是吧？

scripts.text: I love this city so much,
I've even been doing research on it! If there's anything you wanna know about Payon, please ask me!
scripts.translation: 城了，連它的歷史文化我都研究過！想知道什麼，儘管問我！

scripts.text: The people wear unique clothing here.
What's the building in the middle of town?
scripts.translation: 城鎮中間的那棟建築是什麼？

scripts.text: Who's that guy drinking over there?
scripts.translation: 那邊那個在喝酒的傢伙是誰？

scripts.text: You must know this place used to be isolated because of the thick forests and the mountainous area.
scripts.translation: 也這麼覺得。這裡過去被茂密的森林和群山環繞，一直與外界隔絕。

scripts.text: Because of that, the Payon developed a culture of its own, which is quite different than that of the rest of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation: 所以，斐揚形成了自己的文化，和盧恩·米德加茲的其他地方大不相同。

scripts.text: This garment is traditional Payon clothing! Why don't you try wearing one? It's very comfortable~
scripts.translation: 這身就是斐揚傳統服飾！你也試著穿一件吧，很舒服的~

scripts.text: You mean the Central Palace? Strangers aren't allowed to enter that place. People say the royal family and their friends from outside gather there.
scripts.translation: 你說中央宮？那裡不讓陌生人進去。聽說王室和他們從外地來的朋友，都會在那裡聚會。

scripts.text: I'd like to go there sometime, and see what it's like on the inside!
scripts.translation: 我也想找機會進去，看看裡面到底是什麼樣！

scripts.text: let's talk again and I can tell you why the Payon Archers are
scripts.translation: 來聊吧。我會告訴你，斐揚弓箭手為什麼這麼
